weekly_overview:
Give me an overview of the school's week from Monday {{from}} through Sunday {{to}}.

Call the tool `schedule` with from {{from}} and to {{to}}. Then summarize the week day by day, in English:

- Cancellations: the lessons whose status is canceled.
- Full lessons: the lessons without free places (freePlaces 0). Leave out room rentals (kind rental), which take no bookings.
- Free places: the other lessons, each with the number of places left.

End with the week's totals: lessons, canceled lessons and full lessons. The results give times as UTC instants: show them in the school's time zone, {{zone}}. Name a lesson by its course type, day, time and room, not by its ID, and add nothing that the results do not say.
waitlist_invitations:
Whom should the school invite from the waiting list of the lesson {{lessonId}}?

Call the tool `lesson` with lessonId {{lessonId}}: it returns the lesson with its bookings and its waiting list. Then answer in English:

- How many places are free (freePlaces), and how many places open invites hold (held), each with the time its invite expires (expiresAt).
- Who is next: the entries with status waiting, in the order of their position (1 is next), as many as there are free places.
- The school invites waiting entries in this order by itself as soon as a place becomes free. Say whether that already covers the free places, or what keeps it from doing so.

Don't book or invite anyone yourself: the office decides. Name persons only as the results name them; a person marked anonymized is a deleted person. The results give times as UTC instants: show them in the school's time zone, {{zone}}.
canceled_lesson_announcement:
Draft an announcement about the canceled lesson {{lessonId}}, in English.

First find the lesson: call the tool `schedule` and look for the lesson with the ID {{lessonId}}. If you don't know its date, ask me for it, or search from today, {{today}}, in ranges of at most {{maxScheduleDays}} days. If its status is not canceled, tell me so and stop.

Then write:

- a title of at most {{maxTitle}} characters that names the course type and the date;
- a body in plain text of at most {{maxBody}} characters: which lesson is canceled (course type, day, time in the school's time zone {{zone}}, room and location) and what the members need to know. Give a reason or an alternative only if I tell you one, and invent none.

Those booked for the lesson got a mail about the cancellation already. Suggest whom the announcement is for: the members of the lesson's class (and those booked for its coming lessons) or the members of its course type. "Participants of a lesson" reaches only those booked for the lesson.

This is a draft only: publish nothing. No tool saves an announcement, so give me the text only; the office reviews it and publishes it in the app.
